static_traits.name: Li Ming
static_traits.family_status: 有少数亲友可提供支持，但来访者not愿与其讨论财务Anxiety
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness；过去经历过财务困难与破产；此前not yet因类似心理问题接受过治疗
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、配合度高、逻辑性较强；情绪Anxiety但Neutral attitude；能回忆并描述自动化思维

basic_info.main_problem: 因过往破产经历导致对失去所有钱财的过度担忧与Anxiety，这种迫近的财务“灾难感”自上次破产后一直持续，并在经济下行或市场波动时加剧。
basic_info.core_demands: 恐惧与Anxiety已影响其决策能力与整体福祉，寻求咨询中的支持与指导以缓解Anxiety并改善决策。
growth_experiences: 曾经历多次破产与严重财务困难，自此对经济下行、市场波动与负面财经新闻高度敏感；虽尝试财务管理技巧并咨询理财顾问，但Anxiety反复出现并逐渐加剧。

core_beliefs: 我的财务决策not可靠，终将让我破产

special_situations.event: Hearing or seeing bad news about market declines (such as last week's market drop)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: As long as the market has a pullback, it will eventually develop into a full crash and I will go bankrupt again
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Panic divestment, excessive caution to the point of decision paralysis
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: It is over; I am going to lose everything again this time

special_situations.event: Economic downturn or negative macro news
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Any negative sign means I will repeat the same mistakes and sooner or later lose all my money
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Sells early, avoids any risky investment
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: not管怎样我迟早会一without所有

special_situations.event: When small setbacks or fluctuations occur in business or investments
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If a small setback occurs, it means the whole thing is doomed to fail
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Self-harshness and reduced decision-making, procrastination, or making extreme adjustments

special_situations.event: Facing the need to make new investment/financial decisions
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 只要我做错一次决定，就会一without所有；要么完全安全要么彻底失败
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: not决策或极端保守/迅速撤出以求“绝对安全”
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will likely get it wrong and lose everything

core_conflict.wish: 渴望财务上的安全感与可控性，渴望not再经历失败
core_conflict.fear: Fears going bankrupt again and losing everything, fears wrong decisions ruining life
defense_goal: Avoids risk by maintaining high vigilance and control
与风险保持距离（撤出投资、冻结决策）以降低Anxiety

object_relations.self_representation: 脆弱、易失败、对决策not自信的自我
object_relations.object_representation: 充满威胁且not可预测的外部环境/市场

manifestations: 虽有少数亲友可倾诉，但对财务Anxietynot愿开口，倾向于独自承受
When the market fluctuates, falls into self-rumination, finding it hard to get comfort from relationships

contact_model.definition: 个体克制想对其他人或物做出某个行为的冲动，或是放弃了向外寻求do not人为其做某事，转而对自己做，即个体将原欲对外发出的能量转而对自己
manifestations: 对财务Anxietynot与亲友沟通，选择自己消化
Under high-pressure situations, turns help-seeking and communication into self-restraint and tension

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact
manifestations: 反复强调“做错决定就会一without所有”，在讨论投资时过度谨慎甚至瘫痪
In sessions, rational narration overrides emotional experience; tone is cautious

positive_force: After bankruptcy, still able to rebuild finances; the objective situation is better than before
Proactively seeks external professional opinions (consulting a financial advisor); has help-seeking awareness
Has some social support network (a few family and friends to talk with)
negative_force: 灾难化、预测not yet来、过度概括等负性认知加工
Anxiety驱动下的决策瘫痪或恐慌性撤资，影响业务表现
Highly sensitive to negative market information, overly attentive to risk signals
回避与亲友讨论财务Anxiety，减少现实检验与情绪支持
Sleep impaired与持续紧张降低认知与决策能力

target_behavior.behavior: 在财务与市场波动时出现强烈Anxiety并作出恐慌性决策或陷入决策瘫痪
antecedent: 经济下行或宏观not利信号
Small setbacks or short-term fluctuations in business/investments
Facing new investment or financial decisions
target_behavior.core_reason: 过往破产经历形成的威胁记忆与灾难化、预测not yet来、过度概括等认知偏差
target_behavior.function: 逃避not确定性与潜在损失，获得短期的安全感与控制感
target_behavior.consequence: 睡眠与Decreased quality of life；业务表现受损；Interpersonal tension，整体福祉降低
